title: Observe sun, wind and access before planting
subcategory: Observe sun, wind and access before planting
summary: Map the growing area before spending seed or labour.
steps: Observe the site at morning, midday and late afternoon; note direct sun, reflected heat and deep shade.
Mark strong-wind corridors, roof runoff, animal access, trip hazards and places that remain waterlogged.
Place frequently harvested crops near safe daily access and water.
Start with one small test bed or two containers and record results for two weeks.
Expand only where plants receive suitable light and drainage.
